question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right winger, Bob is playing sweeper, Claire is playing left midfielder, Dave is playing right midfielder, Eve is playing left winger, Fred is playing benchwarmer, and Gertrude is playing striker.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Dave trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Alice trade positions. Then, Dave and Claire trade positions. Then, Bob and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Dave and Fred trade positions. Finally, Eve and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Dave is playing
Options:
(A) right winger
(B) sweeper
(C) left midfielder
(D) right midfielder
(E) left winger
(F) benchwarmer
(G) striker
solution:
Each row lists positions in the order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (right winger, sweeper, left midfielder, right midfielder, left winger, benchwarmer, striker)
1. Eve swaps with Alice: (left winger, sweeper, left midfielder, right midfielder, right winger, benchwarmer, striker)
2. Bob swaps with Dave: (left winger, right midfielder, left midfielder, sweeper, right winger, benchwarmer, striker)
3. Gertrude swaps with Alice: (striker, right midfielder, left midfielder, sweeper, right winger, benchwarmer, left winger)
4. Dave swaps with Claire: (striker, right midfielder, sweeper, left midfielder, right winger, benchwarmer, left winger)
5. Bob swaps with Gertrude: (striker, left winger, sweeper, left midfielder, right winger, benchwarmer, right midfielder)
6. Dave swaps with Fred: (striker, left winger, sweeper, benchwarmer, right winger, left midfielder, right midfielder)
7. Eve swaps with Claire: (striker, left winger, right winger, benchwarmer, sweeper, left midfielder, right midfielder)
Dave is the benchwarmer, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
